text:
Riley: Quick thought  rooftop picnic + tiny karaoke setup this Friday 6pm? casual, BYO blanket/food. Low-key, sing if you want. Who's up for it?
Tomo: Love this. In for 6pm. I can bring a Bluetooth speaker and a mic. :microphone: 
Ally: Possibly in, depending on commute. Whats the rain plan?
Riley: Good q. If rain we'll move to 7F lounge (indoor) or postpone.
Jin: In! Karaoke = yes. Can someone bring a laptop with a YouTube playlist?
Jules: I'll make a short karaoke playlist. Any song bans? (looking at you, "Bohemian" addicts) :joy: 
Riley: Haha no bans, but let's keep volume neighbor-friendly. Also vegan options please.
Ally: RSVP tentative until i know if i can get out of an evening meeting.
Tomo: /poll "Friday plan" "Rooftop picnic + karaoke (6pm)" "Indoor lounge (7pm)" "Postpone to next week"
office-bot: Poll posted: Friday plan. Vote by 3pm today.
Jin: FYI im bringing veggie sushi and GF snacks.
Riley: awesome. If poll splits we can do rooftop for early folks and move indoors later for anyone who comes after.
Jules: Also can we put a tiny sign "quiet mic" next to speaker? so only one mic at a time.
Tomo: good call. i'll bring a mic stand and one mic.
Ally: bumping to say if indoor, can we reserve the lounge? @facilities?
office-bot: Facilities notified: lounge reservation request sent.
Riley: thanks everyone. i'll post final spot at 3:15 after poll. low-friction, low-pressure vibes. :sun_with_face:
